description.p: A classdef file defines a class template. The file contains one class definition and the file name must match the class name.

A class definition can contain properties, methods, events, and enumeration blocks. Properties hold object state. Methods implement behavior. Events and listeners are used by handle classes that notify other code when something changes.
Value classes copy their data when assigned. Handle classes inherit from handle and use reference semantics, so two variables can refer to the same object.

Nelson also provides lightweight mixin classes under nelson.mixin. nelson.mixin.Copyable adds a shallow copy method for handle classes. nelson.mixin.CustomDisplay routes scalar display through a protected displayScalarObject method when the class defines one.

Property declarations can include a default value, fixed-size and type validation, and validator functions. Accessor methods named get.PropertyName and set.PropertyName implement computed or validated property access. Dependent properties are not stored; Transient properties are not persisted; NonCopyable handle properties are reset by the copy mixin.

The generated static method ClassName.empty(...) creates typed empty arrays. Indexed expansion initializes missing value-class elements with default property values and missing handle-class elements with distinct default handles.

saveObjectImpl and static loadObjectImpl customize persistence. For non-empty arrays they run element by element. Empty arrays keep their type and size without invoking scalar hooks, and handle arrays are checked for invalid elements before save hooks run.

example_item.example_item_description: Create a first value class in a file named MyClass.m.
example_item.example_item_data:
classdef MyClass properties Value end
methods function obj = MyClass(val) if nargin > 0 obj.Value = val; end end end end
a = MyClass(42); disp(a.Value)

example_item.example_item_description: Use private storage and a dependent property.
example_item.example_item_data:
classdef Person properties (Access = private) AgeInternal = 0 end
properties Name (1,1) string = "" end
properties (Dependent) Age end
methods function obj = Person(name, age) if nargin > 0 obj.Name = name; obj.AgeInternal = age; end end
function v = get.Age(obj) v = obj.AgeInternal; end end end
p = Person("Ada", 31); p.Age

example_item.example_item_description: Inherit from a superclass and call its constructor and method.
Add shallow copy support to a handle class.

example_item.example_item_data:
classdef Point2D < nelson.mixin.CustomDisplay properties X (1,1) double = 0 Y (1,1) double = 0 end
methods function obj = Point2D(x, y) if nargin > 0 obj.X = x; obj.Y = y; end end end
methods (Access = protected) function displayScalarObject(obj) fprintf("Point2D: (%.2f, %.2f)\n", obj.X, obj.Y); end end end
p = Point2D(3.5, 4.2); p
